create_multires_hubert_task: create a MultiresHubertPretrainingTask instance with a MultiresHubertPretrainingConfig for multiresolution HuBERT pretraining
load_hubert_dataset: load a HuBERT dataset for a given split using MultiresHubertPretrainingTask load_dataset method
configure_multires_hubert_pretraining: configure MultiresHubertPretrainingConfig with label rate ratios, sample rate, and label directories
encode_labels_with_labelencoder: encode label strings into token IDs using the LabelEncoder class with a fairseq Dictionary
load_hubert_dictionaries: load label dictionaries for multiresolution HuBERT pretraining using the load_dictionaries method
